messages.subject: Characterize Environmental Space more than 2 species
parts:
Hi!

Does anyone know of a way to conduct the analyses done in the Characterize Environmental Space component for more than 2 species?

If this is not possible, does anyone have recommendations for running ordination analyses on 3 species with both occurrence and background points (as is done in the Wallace component)?

Thanks!
